status_semantics.GT-B: controlled identity, mixture, treatment, or protocol truth
status_semantics.SS: silver-standard author annotation or matched external reference
status_semantics.SIM: simulation truth with known generating parameters
status_semantics.RV: real-project expert review without complete cell-level truth
status_semantics.ENG: engineering fixture; cannot support a scientific performance claim

license_policy.REPOSITORY_TERMS: Public analysis access is available, but the repository does not transfer all contributor rights; redistribution requires source review.
license_policy.EXPLICIT_OPEN: The named data license was verified on the download record.
license_policy.GENERATED_LOCAL: The benchmark is generated locally; package license and source-data rights remain separate.
license_policy.PRIVATE_USER_CONTROLLED: Use is governed by the originating project approvals and consent.
license_policy.REVIEW: A dataset-specific license was not verified; do not redistribute.

qc_input_contract.estimand: Integrity and fail-closed handling of the count matrix, provenance, assay, and sample/library identity before QC review.

qc_profile_selection.estimand: Selection and disclosure of an assay-appropriate safety profile without imposing one universal mitochondrial cutoff.

qc_selector_superiority.estimand: Low-quality-cell recall at a fixed expert KEEP false-removal guardrail.

qc_catastrophic_sample_detection.estimand: Detection of locked failed samples without falsely blocking locked high-quality libraries.

qc_doublet_calibration.estimand: Selection and calibration of a doublet evidence head against experimental labels.

qc_cell_calling.estimand: Recovery of true cells, including low-RNA cells, from an unfiltered droplet matrix.

qc_ambient_correction.estimand: Removal of cross-species or known soup contamination without erasing native identity signal.

qc_rare_population_preservation.estimand: False removal and compositional distortion of known rare or QC-atypical populations.

qc_damage_classification.estimand: Recognition of microscopy- or expert-supported damaged cells while protecting independently supported intact cells.

qc_iterative_review.estimand: Incremental value and biological safety of evidence-added second-round QC after a bounded temporary map.

qc_policy_execution.estimand: Exact, reproducible, and count-preserving execution of a reviewed immutable policy.

qc_decisioncard_ux.estimand: Ability of the compact review surface to support the correct next action without project-specific workarounds.

qc_scalability.estimand: Robust bounded execution across registered dataset sizes without unintended dense expansion or nondeterministic decisions.

pp_input_representation_contract.estimand: Integrity, provenance, and consumer-safe separation of counts, normalized full expression, discovery, and integrated representations.

pp_normalization_selection.estimand: Held-out downstream utility of the selected normalization method under protocol, technology, and depth shifts, with the shifted-log baseline retained.

pp_feature_selection.estimand: Held-out identity, rare-population, and biological-program preservation of unsupervised feature selection without circular marker injection.

pp_selector_regret.estimand: Held-out task utility of the policy-selected preprocessing candidate relative to the best eligible candidate.

pp_graph_stability.estimand: Stability of the selected discovery representation and neighborhood conclusions across registered seeds, feature counts, dimensions, and neighborhood sizes.

pp_integration_need_confounding.estimand: Correct recommendation of no integration, integration review, or fail-closed blocking under unnecessary correction and batch-biological confounding scenarios.

pp_integration_pareto.estimand: Batch removal subject to biological-conservation, rare-population, and stability guardrails.

pp_identity_preservation.estimand: Preservation of externally known cell identity across protocol, technology, center, or depth perturbations.

pp_tumor_structure_preservation.estimand: Preservation of patient, lineage, and tumor-program structure relative to the simple unintegrated baseline.

pp_policy_execution.estimand: Exact, deterministic, count-preserving execution of an explicitly reviewed preprocessing policy.

pp_decisioncard_ux.estimand: Ability of the compact preprocessing review to support the correct consumer-specific action without project-specific workarounds.

pp_scalability.estimand: Sparse, bounded, and reproducible preprocessing across registered dataset sizes on declared reference hardware.

an_annotation_accuracy.estimand: Accuracy and calibration of hierarchical annotation against independent labels.

an_pseudobulk_de.estimand: Replicated condition effect estimated at the biological-sample level.

an_composition.estimand: Recovery of known cell-type proportions and sample-level differential abundance.

an_perturbation_program.estimand: Recovery of treatment and dose programs in held-out perturbations.

an_trajectory_future.estimand: Agreement of inferred fate or ordering with clone and time labels.

datasets.display_name: Lin et al. PDAC primary and metastatic cohort
datasets.truth_detail: Known catastrophic sample GSM4679533 plus blinded expert KEEP/REMOVE/UNCERTAIN regions; not a universal QC gold standard.
limitations: GSM4679533 is a failure control, not evidence that the cohort is globally high quality.
Author cell labels in the current local fixture are missing or unreliable.

datasets.display_name: Schlesinger et al. human PDAC sample
datasets.truth_detail: Single human PDAC sample GSM4293555 for out-of-cohort behavior and tumor-signal sensitivity review.
limitations: One human sample cannot validate cross-sample borrowing or sample-level inference.

datasets.truth_detail: Six-patient PDAC study with author cell-state annotations and matched spatial context; annotations are a silver standard.
limitations: Author annotations and spatial co-localization are informative but are not independent cell-level QC truth.

datasets.truth_detail: Author annotations, patient/tumor/blood structure, and cross-species cohort context.
limitations: Human FASTQ files are unavailable for privacy reasons; do not use the human arm for raw cell-calling claims.

datasets.display_name: Lee et al. colorectal cancer cohort
datasets.truth_detail: Author cell annotations across 23 tumors and 10 matched normal mucosa samples.
limitations: The public UMI matrix is already filtered; no raw-droplet or cell-calling validation is supported.

datasets.truth_detail: Genotype-based donor and multiplet labels plus eight-donor paired control/IFN design.
limitations: Demuxlet labels mainly identify genotype-detectable inter-donor multiplets and do not cover all same-donor doublets.

datasets.truth_detail: Hashtag oligo assignments provide independent sample and multiplet evidence.
limitations: HTO failures and homotypic doublets must be reported separately.
GEO supplies candidate RNA barcodes and raw HTO counts, not the complete unfiltered RNA droplet universe; complete RNA cell-calling performance is not evaluable.

datasets.truth_detail: Cell-multiplexing oligo labels and curated doublet information across kidney captures.
limitations: Hash-based truth has its own negative/ambiguous class and is not perfect truth for homotypic doublets.

datasets.truth_detail: Species identity and mixed-species droplets provide controlled cell-calling, doublet, and ambient-contamination evidence.
limitations: Two robust cell lines do not reproduce fragile primary tumor lineages.

datasets.display_name: SampleQC simulations and 172-sample anonymized QC metrics
datasets.truth_detail: Known simulated healthy/outlier labels plus anonymized QC metrics from 867k nuclei across 172 samples.

license.identifier: CC-BY-4.0 article/data unless otherwise credited; MIT analysis code

limitations: The full 172-sample expression matrix is not public; only QC-space questions are evaluable.

datasets.truth_detail: Known cell-line identity, controlled RNA/cell mixtures, and protocol labels.
limitations: Released objects were already sample-QC filtered and are not low-quality-cell truth.

datasets.display_name: Mereu et al. multicenter protocol benchmark
datasets.truth_detail: Standardized reference mixture measured across centers and 13 single-cell/single-nucleus protocols.
limitations: Reference mixtures emphasize technical variation more than primary-tissue biology.

datasets.truth_detail: Same-source human/mouse mixture, PBMC, and cortex aliquots measured with seven technologies and replicate experiments.
limitations: Some cell types use silver-standard rather than experimental labels.

datasets.truth_detail: Curated author cell-type labels and batch structure across pancreas studies.
limitations: Author annotations are silver standard and may share preprocessing assumptions with the benchmark object.

datasets.truth_detail: Pre-sorted PBMC populations combined into known equal and unequal mixtures.

license.identifier: Bioconductor package and source-data terms must be checked separately

limitations: FACS labels can contain sorting impurity and the artificial mixtures do not represent tumor states.

datasets.truth_detail: Four human donors with author cell-type labels.
limitations: Normal pancreas cannot validate malignant or treatment programs.

datasets.truth_detail: Known cell-line identity across a large pan-cancer collection with curated recurrent programs.

license.identifier: NCBI-GEO terms; SCP terms require separate review

limitations: Cell-line programs are controlled but less representative of primary TME lineages.

datasets.truth_detail: Locally generated counts with locked degradation, rare-population, batch, and effect parameters.

license.identifier: MIT software; generated data inherit source-data constraints

limitations: Simulation pass is necessary but cannot replace experimental or real-project evidence.

datasets.truth_detail: Known cluster-specific DE/DD/DP/DM/DB state changes with explicit sample and group structure.

license.identifier: GPL-3 software; generated data inherit reference-data constraints

limitations: Rankings may depend on the generating model; repeat across parameter grids and real matched references.

datasets.display_name: Squair matched scRNA/bulk DE benchmark compendium
datasets.truth_detail: Eighteen matched single-cell/bulk perturbation datasets and null benchmarks across species and systems.

license.identifier: Verify the Zenodo record and each source dataset before redistribution

limitations: Matched bulk is an external approximation to truth, not exact cell-state-specific ground truth.

datasets.truth_detail: Blinded expert review, project design, expected biology, and usability evidence under leave-one-project-out validation.
limitations: Expert review is not independent experimental truth; claims remain project-specific.

datasets.display_name: Microscopy-labelled intact, damaged, and empty capture sites
datasets.truth_detail: Microscopy inspection provides an external label for intact cells, visibly damaged cells, and empty capture sites; labels remain an imperfect phenotype rather than molecular ground truth.

license.identifier: Ilicic article/supplement CC-BY-4.0; ENA repository terms; ZetaSuite file-level terms

limitations: Legacy Fluidigm C1/Smart-seq technology differs from current droplet scRNA-seq.
Microscopy cannot identify every molecularly compromised or recoverable cell.
The local processed reconstruction covers 168 runs with 147 explicit labels; the source workbook contains 960 capture-site labels.

datasets.display_name: scLucid deterministic controlled QC truth suite
datasets.truth_detail: Locally generated counts with explicit intact, low-RNA, rare, damaged, empty, doublet, ambient, assay-profile, and library labels.
limitations: Simulation can falsify engineering and mechanism assumptions but cannot establish real-world scientific superiority.
PASS on engineering endpoints must not promote simulated scientific endpoints to PASS.

datasets.display_name: scLucid deterministic controlled Preprocess contract fixture
datasets.truth_detail: A deterministic 120-cell by 160-gene synthetic UMI object generated inside the maintained public review/apply contract runner; the transient input object is not persisted as a scientific dataset.
limitations: Contract evidence only; the small synthetic fixture cannot establish scientific performance, external generalization, tumor-program preservation, or production-scale memory bounds.

datasets.truth_detail: Single healthy-donor PBMC object for smoke tests and representation-contract checks; it has no independent cell-level truth.
limitations: Engineering fixture only; one donor and absent external labels cannot support QC or preprocessing superiority claims.

datasets.truth_detail: Small local fixture for raw-droplet schema, likely-cell, and likely-empty contract tests.

license.identifier: Source dataset terms must be verified

limitations: Engineering fixture only; it cannot establish ambient-correction performance.

datasets.truth_detail: Expressed clone barcodes, time points, cytokine conditions, and transcriptional states.
limitations: Future module only; not counted toward current Analysis CORE readiness.

datasets.truth_detail: Known compound, dose, cell line, well, and replicate assignments from nuclear hashing.
limitations: Future program-analysis gate; not counted toward current Analysis CORE readiness.
